lines: Many people drive cars every day.
In the future, what cars will people drive?
Many batteries move the car along.
People have to charge the car like their phone.
They are a mix of a car and small airplane.
They don't go as high as an airplane.
But with this car, you can go anywhere quickly.
So people can just relax in this car.
The sensors get information from around the car.
These cars use this information to drive safely.
body.text: Many people drive cars every day. But these cars are changing. In the future, what cars will people drive? Electric cars They use electricity for power. They don't make air pollution. Many batteries move the car along. People have to charge the car like their phone. Flying cars They run in the air. They are a mix of a car and small airplane. They don't go as high as an airplane. But with this car, you can go anywhere quickly. Self-driving cars They drive for people. So people can just relax in this car. They have sensors. The sensors get information from around the car. These cars use this information to drive safely.
